title: Wolfia vs Inventive AI for RFPs and security questionnaires
summary: Inventive AI offers an RFP agent and a sales agent. Wolfia answers security questionnaires, with a trust center and contract review. How the two compare.
body_markdown:
Inventive AI offers an RFP agent and a sales agent. Wolfia answers security questionnaires, with a trust center and contract review. How the two compare.


Inventive AI builds two AI agents, an RFP Agent for RFPs and security questionnaires and a Sales Agent for CRM updates and forecasting. Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center, and this page compares the two using only what each company publishes.


## What Inventive AI is


Inventive AI’s homepage says, “We built two dedicated AI agents.” The RFP Agent drafts responses to RFPs, security questionnaires and DDQs from a company’s own knowledge, with a source citation and a confidence score on each answer, and flags questions the knowledge cannot support instead of guessing. A Chrome extension, turned on per portal page, drafts and inserts answers in vendor portals such as Ariba and ServiceNow. Inventive AI describes a trust center as a separate tool and says its product can work alongside one.


## What Wolfia is


Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center. It answers security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs from a company’s own documents and past answers, gives every answer a cited source, and leaves an answer empty when no document supports it. It works on Excel, Word and PDF files and exports them in their original format, and a Chrome extension fills answers back into web portals. The[Wolfia facts page](https://wolfia.com/facts) lists the rest, including hosting on Amazon Web Services in the United States and SOC 2 Type II.


## Inventive AI and Wolfia side by side


Inventive AI cells come from Inventive AI’s own pages, read 26 November 2026, and Wolfia cells from Wolfia’s published facts.


Inventive AI Wolfia


Primary use An RFP Agent for RFPs and security questionnaires, and a Sales Agent for CRM updates, stale deals and forecasting An AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center


Security questionnaires Drafts every response from your own knowledge; names SIG, SIG Lite, CAIQ, VSAQ, VSA, NIST 800-171, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and custom questionnaires, and checks answers against framework controls Answers security questionnaires and DDQs from your own documents and past answers ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


File formats Exports to Excel, Word or PDF, or answers inside the buyer’s portal Excel, Word and PDF, exported back in the original format


Web portals Chrome extension turned on per portal page, for Ariba, ServiceNow and most vendor-built and custom questionnaire portals The Chrome extension extracts the questions from web portals and fills the answers back ([Chrome Extension Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/chrome-extension) )


Trust center Describes a trust center as a separate tool and says Inventive “can work alongside a Trust Center.” Access requests and online NDA signing, where one signed NDA carries across documents ([Trust Center](https://wolfia.com/products/trust-center) )


RFPs Yes, the RFP Agent covers RFPs, security questionnaires and DDQs Answers RFPs from the same documents and past answers


Contract review MSA Agents that review legal redlines, offered as early access in the AI Revenue Execution product AI contract review and obligation tracking, with redlines exported as tracked changes ([Customer Contract Intelligence](https://wolfia.com/products/customer-contract-intelligence) )


Knowledge sources Syncs past RFPs and content from SharePoint and Google Drive into its Knowledge Hub; the homepage also names Confluence, Slack and Salesforce Including Google Drive, Confluence, SharePoint, OneDrive, GitHub, GitLab, Glean, Guru, Slab, Mintlify and Letter AI ([Knowledge Base Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/knowledge-base-agent) )


Citations Every answer includes a source citation and a confidence score Every answer comes with a cited source


Human review Agents flag anything they cannot back up, and “Your team just approves.” Your subject matter experts review the drafts and only handle the questions where Wolfia is unsure or found no source ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


Pricing RFP Automation starts at $833 a month billed annually in the plan card and FAQ, and the same page also says pricing starts from $830 a month; AI Revenue Execution is a custom quote Plans start at $500 a month ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


Pricing model Usage-based, paying for the RFPs you process, with unlimited users and no per-seat charge Every plan covers security questionnaires, contract reviews and the trust center, with unlimited users; pricing scales with volume, not headcount


Hosting region Not stated on Inventive AI’s site Amazon Web Services in the United States ([Wolfia trust center](https://trust.wolfia.com/) )


Certifications SOC 2 Type II compliant SOC 2 Type II, and certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework


Free trial Free trials offered, per its RFP response services page A “Get started for free” sign-up on wolfia.com; paid plans are scoped on one short call ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


## Where Wolfia is ahead


Each point below is backed by the table above or by the page it links.


- Wolfia includes a trust center with access requests and online NDA signing. Inventive AI describes a trust center as a separate tool that it works alongside.
- Contract review is part of every Wolfia plan. Inventive AI offers MSA Agents for legal redlines as early access, in its separate AI Revenue Execution product.
- Wolfia plans start at $500 a month. Inventive AI’s RFP Automation starts at $833 a month, billed annually.


## Which team each fits


Inventive AI fits a revenue team that answers RFPs and security questionnaires and also wants an AI agent for CRM updates, stale deals and forecasting from the same vendor, priced on the number of RFPs it processes.


Wolfia fits a security or compliance team whose workload is inbound security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs in files and web portals, and that wants a trust center and contract review on the same plan. It also answers security questions in Slack through the[Slack Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/slack-autorespond) , and in Claude and ChatGPT through the[Wolfia connector](https://wolfia.com/blog/connect-wolfia-to-claude-and-chatgpt) .

## FAQ


### What does Inventive AI do?


Inventive AI offers two AI agents. The RFP Agent automates RFPs and security questionnaires, drafting from a company’s own knowledge with a source citation and a confidence score on each answer, and the Sales Agent automates CRM updates, flags stale deals and forecasts.


### How much does Inventive AI cost?


Inventive AI’s pricing page lists RFP Automation from $833 a month billed annually, and the same page also says its usage-based pricing starts from $830 a month billed annually, with unlimited users. Wolfia plans start at $500 a month with unlimited users.


### Does Inventive AI include a trust center?


Inventive AI describes a trust center as a separate tool and says its product can work alongside one. Every Wolfia plan includes a trust center with access requests and online NDA signing.


### Do Inventive AI and Wolfia review contracts?


Inventive AI lists MSA Agents that review legal redlines as early access in its AI Revenue Execution product. Wolfia includes AI contract review and obligation tracking, with redlines exported as tracked changes.
